nodes.summary: For a chain conditional random field with a finite set of states, weights in a semiring, unary potentials $u_t(s)$ and transition potentials $\tau_t(s', s)$ given the observation stream $x$, the forward variables are defined by $\alpha_0(s) = u_0(s)$ and $\alpha_{t+1}(s) = \left(\sum_{s'} \alpha_t(s')\, \tau_t(s', s)\right) u_{t+1}(s)$, the sum running over all states $s'$.
nodes.title: Forward variables of a chain CRF

nodes.summary: Let $h$ be a hidden Markov model with nonnegative weights in a linearly ordered commutative semiring, and let $x$ be an observation stream. For every $t$ and every state path $z = (z_0, \dots, z_t)$, the weight of $z$ in the chain CRF of $h$ given $x$ equals the joint weight in $h$ of the state path $z$ and the observations $x_0, \dots, x_t$.
nodes.title: The chain CRF of a hidden Markov model has the same path weights

nodes.summary: Let $h$ be a hidden Markov model with initial weights $\pi(s)$, transition weights $a(s, s')$ and emission weights $b(s, o)$ in a linearly ordered commutative semiring, all nonnegative. Its chain CRF has, for every observation stream $x$, unary potentials $u_0(s) = \pi(s)\, b(s, x_0)$ and $u_t(s) = b(s, x_t)$ for $t \ge 1$, and transition potentials $\tau_t(s, s') = a(s, s')$ at every step $t$.
nodes.title: The chain CRF of a hidden Markov model

nodes.summary: For a chain conditional random field with a finite set of states and weights in a semiring, and an observation stream $x$, for every $t$ the partition function at time $t$ equals $\sum_s \alpha_t(s)$, the sum over all states $s$ of the forward variables $\alpha_t(s)$.

nodes.summary: For a chain conditional random field with states $0, \dots, n - 1$ and weights in a semiring, and an observation stream $x$, the tabulated partition function at time $t$ is the sum of the entries of the forward table at time $t$, the vector $(\alpha_t(0), \dots, \alpha_t(n - 1))$ of forward variables computed step by step from time $0$.
nodes.title: The tabulated forward algorithm for chain CRFs

nodes.summary: For a chain conditional random field with a finite set of states and weights in a semiring, and an observation stream $x$, the partition function at time $t$ is $Z_t = \sum_z w_t(z)$, the total weight of all label paths $z$ of length $t + 1$, where $w_t(z)$ is the unnormalized weight of $z$ given $x$.
nodes.title: Partition function of a chain CRF

nodes.summary: For a chain conditional random field with states $0, \dots, n - 1$ where $n \ge 1$, weights in a linearly ordered commutative semiring, and an observation stream $x$, for every $t$ and every state $s$ the weight of the backtracked path of length $t + 1$ ending in $s$, obtained by following the backpointers, equals the Viterbi variable at time $t$ of $s$.

nodes.summary: For a chain conditional random field with states $0, \dots, n - 1$ where $n \ge 1$, weights in a linearly ordered commutative semiring, and an observation stream $x$, for every $t$ and every label path $z$ of length $t + 1$, the weight of $z$ is at most the weight of Viterbi's MAP path of length $t + 1$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
